functional.summary: Functional check of the judge-outage surface through the tap-budget harness (S6) and the IPC/inline suites on the committed T6 tree: with the judge unavailable a DM gets exactly one plain notice sentence before the first offline card, the card reason says why, a second offline request cards without a new notice, an answered verdict resets the episode so the next outage notifies again, trusted-root reads stay silent, an uncovered read asks at most once, Allow with remember still writes the row and the repeat runs with zero cards, and a scheduled job's conversation gets the same single notice before its card. No live provider was available to the checker; the harness drives the same consult paths the providers reach.
scenarios: DM, judge unavailable (llm_unconfigured): one notice 'My safety judge is offline, so I'll check with you more than usual until it's back.' then the card with reason 'Asking because my safety judge is offline.'; second request → card only
Tap Allow with remember; identical request → no card; /permissions lists the row
A read inside the workspace → no notice, no card
Judge restored and answers → next outage notifies once more
Group route: same sequence, one notice per group conversation
Scheduled job with an unavailable judge → one notice to the job conversation, then the job's card with the offline reason
Ask mode and unmapped lanes → no consult, no notice, unchanged
